relationships.subject: compound 25r
relationships.evidence_quote: This compound displayed high selectivity for CB2 against CB1 (CB2 EC50 = 21.0 nM, Emax = 87%, CB1 EC50 > 30 μM, ratio CB1/CB2 > 1428)

relationships.subject: compound 25r
relationships.evidence_quote: Especially, 25r demonstrated significant efficacy in the analgesic model of rodent inflammatory pain.

key_findings: Compound 25r is a selective CB2 agonist (EC50 21.0 nM) with analgesic efficacy in rodent inflammatory pain.
